name: SOC 2
description: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria — technical controls (Security principle)

controls.name: Logical and physical access controls
controls.desc: Access to systems must be restricted to authorized users through strong authentication, network controls, and password policies.

controls.name: Security of external transmissions
controls.desc: Data transmitted externally must be protected with strong encryption. Weak TLS, expired certificates, and unsigned SMB are violations. Data at rest must also be protected.

controls.name: Restriction of data movement
controls.desc: Unauthorized data flows must be prevented. IP forwarding, privileged containers, and legacy SMBv1 enable unrestricted data movement.

controls.name: Prevention of malicious software
controls.desc: Controls must prevent execution of unauthorized code. MAC, anti-malware, and restricted Docker access reduce attack surface.

controls.name: Detection of unauthorized changes
controls.desc: Unauthorized modifications to system files must be detectable. World-writable files, excessive SUID, and core dumps from SUID processes are indicators.

controls.name: Monitoring for security events
controls.desc: Security events including failed authentication and privileged command execution must be monitored to detect and respond to incidents.

controls.name: Change management
controls.desc: Changes to systems must be controlled. Applying security patches, keeping anti-malware signatures fresh, and verifying no reboot is pending are baseline change-management requirements.
